idea.title: AgentBridge — Turn any CLI tool into an MCP server in 5 minutes
idea.global_angle: Every developer worldwide building AI agents needs this

plan.tagline: Turn any CLI tool into an MCP server in 5 minutes
plan.problem: Developers have powerful CLI tools but cannot connect them to Claude, ChatGPT or any AI agent without writing complex MCP server boilerplate.
plan.solution: A Python CLI that wraps any existing command-line tool and auto-generates a working MCP server with proper tool definitions, input schemas, and error handling.
plan.target_market: AI developers worldwide building agents with Claude, GPT, or local LLMs
plan.self_use: JARVIS uses AgentBridge to expose his own tools (pain_scout, evolve, rate) as MCP servers — Claude can then call them directly
mvp_features: Scan a CLI tool and auto-detect its commands and flags
Generate MCP server Python file automatically
Test the MCP connection with a simple ping
--demo mode showing JARVIS tools wrapped as MCP

build_phases.name: CLI scanner + MCP generator
build_phases.description: parse --help output of any CLI tool, generate mcp server skeleton

build_phases.name: Schema builder + test runner
build_phases.description: auto-build input schemas, test MCP connection, validate tools

build_phases.name: JARVIS self-wrap + demo
build_phases.description: wrap jarvis own tools as MCP, demo shows claude calling jarvis directly

self_improvement_angle: Phase 3 wraps JARVIS tools as MCP servers — after this build JARVIS can be called directly by Claude
